task_prompt: Write pytest unit tests for the supplied flight-mode state machine. Cover a permitted transition from IDLE to NOMINAL, rejection when the battery guard fails, and rejection when an attitude guard fails during a transition to SCIENCE. Assert both the return value and resulting mode.
unit_test_code:
from flight_modes import FlightModeMachine, Mode

def test_idle_enters_nominal_when_guards_pass():
    machine = FlightModeMachine(Mode.IDLE)

    accepted = machine.transition(Mode.NOMINAL, battery_ok=True, attitude_valid=True)

    assert accepted is True
    assert machine.mode is Mode.NOMINAL

def test_idle_rejects_nominal_when_battery_guard_fails():
    machine = FlightModeMachine(Mode.IDLE)

    accepted = machine.transition(Mode.NOMINAL, battery_ok=False, attitude_valid=True)

    assert accepted is False
    assert machine.mode is Mode.IDLE

def test_nominal_rejects_science_when_attitude_is_invalid():
    machine = FlightModeMachine(Mode.NOMINAL)

    accepted = machine.transition(Mode.SCIENCE, attitude_valid=False)

    assert accepted is False
    assert machine.mode is Mode.NOMINAL

transition_cases.guard_condition: battery_ok and attitude_valid are both true

expected_behavior: The machine enters NOMINAL from IDLE only when both required guards pass. It rejects requests with a failed guard and preserves the current mode.
expected_assertions: A guarded IDLE-to-NOMINAL request returns true when battery and attitude checks pass.
A rejected transition returns false and leaves the machine in its source mode.
A NOMINAL-to-SCIENCE request is rejected when attitude_valid is false.
